hos_pilgrims_staff.name: Pilgrim's Staff
hos_pilgrims_staff.desc: A walking staff worn smooth by a thousand hands, still faintly warm. Light-based attacks hit a little harder.

hos_moth_mantle.name: Moth Mantle
hos_moth_mantle.desc: A grey cloak that other things find hard to see.

hos_waylamp.name: Second Waylamp
hos_waylamp.desc: The Hospice's second lamp, kept for the lay-brother who held the ladder. It lights the way home. Your lantern burns a little slower.

hos_windfall.name: Windfall Pear
hos_windfall.desc: A pear that tastes of nothing and settles the stomach. Restores 25 health and calms you (Dread -10).

hos_belfry_key.name: Belfry Key
hos_belfry_key.desc: A small iron key on a moth-shaped fob. It opens the belfry door at the Hospice gate.

hos_receipt.name: Receipt: the Moth-Saint's Hospice
hos_receipt.desc: Received of the Hospice of the Moth-Saint, one waylamp, brass, wick trimmed, to guide the Keeper home. Held in trust. To be returned lit. Brother Corvin held the ladder. He says he does not mind. He minds. -A.
